title: Ridgley's band, Don Albert and John Porter
summary: He recalls Ridgley's band lineup, how Don Albert stripped it and John Porter.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. And what about Ridley's band? Well Ridley, I played with Ridley, returned to houses, all uptown, and Emma Barrett was playing And Emma Barrett was playing in that band, and Gilbert Young was playing in that band, and Happy was on drums, Happy Goldston was playing drums. And I believe I saw you one day when you was going up there to do what you're doing with me with Papa before he died up on Edinburgh's day.
With Ridley.
Ridley, yeah. I believe I saw you that day you was up there. Yeah, it might have. Yeah.
Anyway, who else was in the band? You said you had Emma Barrett.
Emma Barrett, Gilbert Young. Yeah, Gilbert Young.
Yeah, the bass player I guess.

And Happy was playing, and she was playing bass and heavy band. It wasn't so long, you know, it's kind of, you played with so many different guys. Yeah. Albert was playing in that band too. Albert Alcorn, he left and went with Don Albert. He was playing in that band. And I don't know much as well. I don't think, I had a time of playing in there too. I can't think of them guys.
He probably had a big sax section I would guess.
No, well he didn't have it, but it was about nine or ten pieces. Well I left him and Johnny Sincere come in the band after I left him. Oh I see. When he came back.
Yeah.
I went on one.
Well he did have a clarinet on sax.

Because Don Albert came in and stripped his band by taking all of them musicians. He didn't take Gibbeth Young because Gibbeth Young was working at the post office in different places. Well he didn't take Miss Barrett either. That's the woman they call Emma, Sweet Emma.
That must have been about twenty-nine. I think I got to know something.
Yeah.
Because I talked to Don every once in a while on the telephone.
Yeah, but he broke up, they went out there to the Red Baron out there in Texas. He had a nightclub out there.
Did you ever work with John Porter?
Yeah. John Porter was the bass player. With who? With Risley at the time. Yeah I see. Yeah, he was the bass player. I couldn't think of it. That's who, he had a Suzy part.
Well I hate to put words in your mouth, but John Porter used to talk to me about that. He kept a book everywhere.
Yeah, John Porter was living down on Simon Bollower and what you call him then at that time?
Oh Ryan Caliocco? Oh Ryan Caliocco.
Yeah, yeah. That's right. He had a good vision to me. Yeah, well he. About twelve ten or something like that.
Yeah, well he was there.
He was with me with this other band too. Yeah.
